pages.text: The smeltery can be any size from 3x3 to 11x11, and any height from a minimum of two. Larger structures increase both the number of items that can smelt at once and the liquid capacity.

The structure requires a floor, but does not require a ceiling or a frame. The floor must be made solely of seared blocks; the walls may use any combination of seared blocks, seared glass, tanks, and drains.
Place the smeltery controller in one of the walls. Once the structure is valid, right-click the controller to open the smeltery interface.
